module: gameplayInterface module relaying to the vehicle extension `vehiclePerformanceData`: starts/stops performance recordings (up to 5 types), reads the recorded data and the vehicle's static data.
notes: Actions 'startRecording' and 'stopRecording'(type1:string, type2?:string, ... type5?:string): call extensions.vehiclePerformanceData.startRecording/stopRecording({the 5 types}).
Lookup 'getRecordingData'(type1:string, ... type5?:string): directly returns the result of extensions.vehiclePerformanceData.getRecordingData.
This extension (vehiclePerformanceData) must be loaded in the vehicle VM, otherwise the call raises an error. It is not in this batch.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Called at load: fills moduleActions and moduleLookups.

requestRegistration.desc: Registers the actions and lookups with gameplayInterface.
